title: F1: retry a spec review that failed without a verdict; hold the task after respawn_max failures
spec:
Goal T-1375. Today daemon.py:981 opens a spec review only when no spec_review child exists for the task (`not any(r["inputs"][:1] == [t["id"]] ...)`); a child that failed (spawn.py:1689 "review returned no parseable verdict", or any status "failed") still counts, so the task stays queued as spec_review_pending forever (T-1355 on 2026-09-23).
Change the spec-review block in orchestrator/daemon.py (the `elif not any(...)` / `else: entry["reason"] = "spec_review_pending"` branches after `elif verdict == "request_changes"`):
1. children = spec_review tasks whose inputs[0] == t["id"]; live = children not in status ("failed", "superseded").
2. No children: unchanged (create one).
3. live non-empty: unchanged (spec_review_pending).
4. Only failed children: if len(failed) < cfg [daemon].respawn_max (default 3): clear_stage(t["id"], "spec_review_at") then create a new spec review exactly as the creation path does (same title/spec/acceptance/scope/role/inputs/parent/complexity/tier, spawn_async(spawn.run_worker, ...), complete(...)); entry reason "spec_review_retry". Else: stamp/hold t with status "held", hold_reason f"spec_review_failed: {len(failed)} spec reviews returned no verdict", and notify(...) once.
Keep the lease sweep (daemon.py:1633) behaviour; it only re-spawns queued unclaimed children.
Tests (unittest.TestCase methods in tests/test_daemon.py, using the existing daemon test fixtures): a task whose only spec review failed gets a second spec review on the next tick; after respawn_max failed reviews the task is held with the spec_review_failed reason; a live pending review is not duplicated.
